vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 555 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Anjali — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Anjali chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Anjali, Stephen, Atlas, Yvonne and Gisele met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Anjali, Stephen, Atlas, Yvonne, Gisele are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Stephen, Atlas, Yvonne, Gisele and Brian met them at the door — 5 put down. Stephen, Atlas, Yvonne, Gisele, Brian are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Atlas just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Atlas, Gisele and Quinn met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Atlas, Quinn are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gisele just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gisele, Brian and Quinn met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Gisele, Brian are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Atlas just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
